'''House Renar''' was one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Denri Ayl]] mediated negotiations between House Renar and [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]], and both houses agreed to donate fifty thousand credits to a charity that Ayl later chose as the [[Broken Valley Relief Fund]].
